subject.title: fix(sqlite): normalize BLOB/TEXT type mismatches during STRICT migration

question: For a true BLOB/TEXT key collision after canonicalization, should OpenClaw retain the current fail-closed manual-recovery behavior or add an explicitly user-confirmed Doctor recovery flow before shipping this migration repair?
rationale: Selecting or removing one of two durable rows is a persisted-state policy choice; the generic migration helper cannot safely make that choice autonomously.

options.title: Keep fail-closed recovery
options.body: Merge only after the tuple-comparison repair, and make the diagnostic accurately state that genuine collisions require manual resolution rather than claiming Doctor can fix them.

options.title: Design a Doctor resolution flow
options.body: Add a separately reviewed, explicitly confirmed Doctor workflow that shows both rows and requires the operator to choose a retention policy before rewriting durable state.

recommendation.title: Keep fail-closed recovery
recommendation.body: Merge only after the tuple-comparison repair, and make the diagnostic accurately state that genuine collisions require manual resolution rather than claiming Doctor can fix them.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced the STRICT migration feature whose persisted-state recovery contract is being extended.
